endpoint_publication.source: Microsoft 365 IP Address and URL web service
endpoint_publication.update_policy: reviewed controlled configuration; never scrape the desktop client

operations.proves: Only DNS, TCP, TLS and the permitted HTTP response for this named front-door operation.
operations.cannot_prove: Teams sign-in, messaging, meetings, media quality, employee-session routing or complete service health.
operations.authentication_requirements: None for the approved unauthenticated operation.

operations.proves: Only reachability and response timing for the approved authentication dependency operation.
operations.cannot_prove: Successful employee authentication, token issuance or Teams application health.
operations.authentication_requirements: No credentials or tokens are sent by the probe.

operations.proves: Nothing until an authorized supported media evidence source is integrated.
operations.cannot_prove: A generic HTTPS probe cannot establish packet loss, jitter, RTT or meeting quality.
operations.authentication_requirements: Microsoft tenant permissions and privacy approval required.

operations.proves: The independent controlled operation was reachable from the same endpoint and context.
operations.cannot_prove: That every destination path or business service is healthy.
